item.tib: tshe sgrub rig 'dzin mchog 'dus kyi zab gnad brla bslu tshe yi g.yung drung
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang nub gcig rmi lam gyi 'khrul snang la btsun pa zhig gis/ tshe dbang bya ri ma'i tshe 'gug sku bstod la kha bsgyar nas sha khrag drod dbugs rnams la 'grel dgos zer nas 'di ltar byed pa'i snang ba byung nas/ 'phral du nyi ming pa des bris pa nyes 'gal mchis par skyabs yul rnams la bshags/ dge ba mchis nas mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
